definitions.explanation: Japan's bicameral legislature consisting of the House of Representatives and House of Councillors.
A national legislative body in general.

examples.japanese: {国会|こっかい}で{法案|ほうあん}が{可決|かけつ}された。
examples.english: The bill was passed in the Diet.

examples.japanese: {国会|こっかい}{議員|ぎいん}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: He was elected as a member of parliament.

examples.japanese: {国会|こっかい}{議事|ぎじ}{堂|どう}を{見学|けんがく}した。
examples.english: I toured the National Diet Building.

examples.japanese: {通常|つうじょう}{国会|こっかい}は{毎年|まいとし}1{月|がつ}に{召集|しょうしゅう}される。{会期|かいき}は150{日間|にちかん}で、{延長|えんちょう}されることもある。
examples.english: The ordinary Diet session is convened every January. The session lasts 150 days and can be extended.

notes:
{国会|こっかい} is Japan's parliament.

JAPAN'S DIET STRUCTURE:
- {衆議院|しゅうぎいん} (House of Representatives - lower house)
- {参議院|さんぎいん} (House of Councillors - upper house)
- {国会|こっかい}{議事|ぎじ}{堂|どう} (National Diet Building)

TYPES OF SESSIONS:
- {通常|つうじょう}{国会|こっかい} (ordinary session)
- {臨時|りんじ}{国会|こっかい} (extraordinary session)
- {特別|とくべつ}{国会|こっかい} (special session)

RELATED TERMS:
- {国会|こっかい}{議員|ぎいん} (Diet member, MP)
- {与党|よとう} (ruling party)
- {野党|やとう} (opposition party)
- {法案|ほうあん} (bill, legislative proposal)
